scenes.line1: How do you update your DB schema?
scenes.say: How do you safely update your database schema as your code evolves? Let’s break down the Entity Framework Core migrations workflow.

scenes.label: Create
scenes.sub: Generate a migration for schema changes.
scenes.say: First, generate a migration whenever your model changes. This creates code to update your schema.

scenes.title: Review Migration
scenes.say: Next, always review the generated migration code. Make sure it matches your intent before moving forward.
Finally, apply the migration with dotnet ef database update. Your database schema now matches your code.

scenes.question: What's the easy step to skip?
scenes.right: Always review migration code before applying, to catch errors early.
scenes.say: Don’t skip reviewing migration code. It’s easy to miss mistakes that could break your database.
